precomparison_requirements: Freeze experimental reference cases and their source-group identifiers
Exclude all reference publications and derived observations from every prediction method
Record all predictions, including abstentions, before opening reference labels
Check exact endpoint and biological model comparability
Prevent any shared-source or shared-variant connected component from crossing evaluation partitions
reporting: Per-mechanism results and source-group clustered uncertainty
Sensitivity to removal of individual publications
Comparison of integrated, KG-only and structural-only methods
prohibitions: No accuracy claim for unfrozen reference cases
No treating multiple endpoints from one paper as independent studies
No treating clinical pathogenicity as equivalent to functional assay direction
No computing a performance score from the public candidate labels
